newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see nearby trade at firmer levels.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see nearby trade at firmer levels.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some demand for nearby material at firmer levels as operators covered immediate needs in a steadier market underpinned by a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening.
"We saw again buying interest for nearby material as prices continue to rise and several operators still need to cover their positions," one broker said.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded $2 up at $260 a tonne cif Rotterdam and Nov at $262 a tonne cif. Promt Dutch high protein soymeal changed hands at $308 a tonne cif Rotterdam.

Tight nearby availability pushed priced for spot and afloat Thai hard tapioca pellets around one mark up from yesterday and spot material traded at 21.50 marks per 100 kg fob Ghent, afloat at 22 marks fob Rotterdam and Dec at 20.70 marks fob Rotterdam.
Spot Argentine sunmeal pellets traded $2 up at $142 a tonne fob Rotterdam, Nov up $1 at $146, Dec at $150 and Jan/March at $132 cif Rotterdam.
Light trade was also reported in Malaysian palmkernel expellers, Philippine copra expellers, and EU rapemeal.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
